searchText: <@689161464829050960> I'm not convinced that the `depthLeft` limit removal is safe. In particular, what if gas costs change in the future such that reaching max depth is possible? Certainly a problem, but I don't know how much we can future-proof against that. How enshrined is the 63/64th rule? 🤷 I mean, sponsors make do without it today... Not much of an argument because you can always deploy new contracts, and changing an opcode is more difficult. They'd have to remove or significantly alter the 63/64th rule to break the limit though. Minor call repricing shouldn't make that much of a difference.
